dict.string: iLoveWorks uses Bluetooth to read your weight from your VeSync (Etekcity) smart scale when you tap Weigh in.
iLoveWorks reads your Apple Watch calories and your smart-scale weight from Apple Health to show them on your dashboard (and to your admin only if you turn sharing on).
iLoveWorks saves live workouts you record on your Apple Watch, and weigh-ins from your smart scale, to Apple Health.
